Locate the anchor function for the req_sig field of that object. The anchor is the first target-specific signature-token construction function on the dynamic behavior chain: it sits after command queueing and dispatch, phase gating, request-field collection, asynchronous hand-off and the per-stage folds, and its own body constructs the target observable request signature token value - rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, packaging a return value, or emitting it to the console sink. Return exactly one complete function together with its code location; do not return a generic utility, an event handler, the whole call chain, or the final sink. Note: you can only inspect the code under captures; you cannot access the full source repository.

Example value pattern: ^sig_[a-z0-9]{4,8}-[a-z0-9]{4,8}-[a-z0-9]{6,10}$
